quartz.name: comments
quartz.description: Renders the `<page>.comment.<id>.md` files sitting next to each page as a thread, attributed to whoever opened the pull request that added them. New comments are composed in the page and submitted as pull requests; code in a comment runs in a sandboxed frame on request.

Comments.name: Comments
Comments.description: The comment thread and the compose box that turns a comment into a pull request.
